description: A run of exactly one test file with --silent under Jest 30.5.2 (T9.7, B21c): `@jest/core`'s runJest leaves verbose off for one file when `globalConfig.silent` is true, so the run is report-single-file's project printed as the default reporter does: the header and the totals, no list of tests and no console output. One Jest worker. A black-box run.
